name: validate-media-sizes.md
html:
shared/scripts/media/validate-media-sizes.mjs

Validates every media size declared in database.json
Sourcesrc/shared/scripts/media/validate-media-sizes.mjs
UX surfaceThe repo verbs — build, verify, test, docs, i18n, media, setup, scaffold.

Members

CDN_BASE

Public object URL prefix — same base the sitemap generator emits.

DB_PATH

database.json at the monorepo root — the CMS export / source of truth.

META_DIR

Persisted manifest next to the sitemap artifacts — listing fallback.

HEADER_RANGE

Bytes fetched per image — JPEG SOF sits inside the first marker run so ~64 KiB usually suffices; 512 KiB covers files carrying large EXIF or embedded thumbnail APP1 segments before the frame header.

IMAGE_DIM_VARIANTS

Image variants usable for dimensions — same-source derivative passes only. The kodak MSSIM thumb is excluded deliberately: it is a downscaled blur-up placeholder and would record the wrong intrinsic size.

VIDEO_DIM_VARIANTS

Video variants — original first, the half-res scaledown never for dims.

jpegDims

Extracts width/height from a JPEG byte stream by scanning markers until a start-of-frame segment (SOF0–SOF15, excluding DHT/DAC/JPG extension markers) whose payload carries precision, height, width.

pngDims

Extracts width/height from the PNG IHDR (fixed offset 16/20).

webpDims

Extracts width/height from a WebP container: lossy VP8 keeps the 14-bit dimensions in the frame tag, lossless VP8L packs them into a 28-bit field, and VP8X stores them as 24-bit minus-one values on the canvas.

svgDims

Reads SVG geometry from the root tag — explicit dims first, viewBox fallback.

imageDims

Probes an image object with a single range GET — JPEG/PNG/WebP headers are parsed locally so only the first HEADER_RANGE bytes travel.

videoDims

Probes a video object's first video stream geometry via ffprobe over HTTPS.

collectMedia

Collects every media node { src, size, isVideo } in the database. Returns a Map of folder + src → { folder, src, size, isVideo, nodes[] } where nodes holds { node, path } for every locale occurrence — node is the live object reference so --fix updates every language at once, and path is the RTDB location (translations/<loc>/projects/…) so --push can write the same leaf remotely.

pickObject

Picks the first bucket object whose suffix marks a source-fidelity variant.

getManifest

Loads the live bucket listing, falling back to the persisted manifest.

RTDB_URL

RTDB REST root — multi-path PATCH target for the live CMS database.

adcToken

Reads a Google OAuth2 access token from gcloud Application Default Credentials — the same auth surface firebase deploy uses, so no service-account key file is needed on a machine that already runs gcloud auth application-default login.

pushLive

Pushes probed intrinsic sizes to the live Firebase RTDB.

Per locale, translations/<loc>/projects is fetched once and every media node's live size is compared against the probed value — only drifted leaves go into the multi-path PATCH, so unchanged rows are never rewritten and the request stays small even on a fully synced database (the PATCH body ends up nearly empty).
